## 🚀 Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

## 🤝 Target Beneficiaries
Who does this feature help?
- [ ] Deaf / Hard-of-Hearing Citizens
- [ ] Frontline Service Staff (Hospitals, Banks, Stations, Gov Offices)
- [ ] Certified ISL Interpreters & Volunteers
- [ ] Institutional Administrators
- [ ] All Users

## ❓ Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or real-world friction point? Please describe.
*Example: Frontline staff often struggle to understand form requirements when offline.*

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented.

## 🎨 User Experience / UI Sketch
Describe how this feature should look or behave in the app (referencing PRD guidelines and accessibility standards).

## 🛡️ Privacy & Ethical AI Considerations
Does this feature involve AI predictions, user feedback, or data storage? Explain how it adheres to our Deaf-first, zero-raw-video-storage principles.

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or references here.
